stops.note: to hang upon, from ad- (to) and pendere (to hang)
formed as a noun for something attached or hanging on
settled as the English word for a small pouch attached to the intestine, and later added text
stops.meaning: a small attached pouch, or supplementary material at the end of a book

current_meaning: a small pouch attached to the large intestine, or supplementary material added to the end of a document
